gbsg2.design: GBSG2 public benchmark; declared stratified 75/25 development/holdout split
gbsg2.holdout_use_warning: Candidate family is selected from development nested CV only; non-winning holdout rows are audit information.
gbsg2.selection_rule: highest repeated nested-CV mean C-index; lower SD then name break ties

protocol.preprocessing: median imputation and scaling fitted inside every fold

tcga_cgga.design: TCGA patient-level development; CGGA external audit
tcga_cgga.external_use_warning: CGGA outcomes were already reported previously; treat as an external audit, not a newly untouched cohort.
tcga_cgga.selection_rule: highest repeated nested-CV mean C-index; lower SD then name break ties
